title: Meetnetten.be night transect counts of fire salamanders on 83 transects, Flanders, Belgium, 2016-2025
creator: Piesschaert, Frederik; Speybroeck, Jeroen; Brosens, Dimitri; Westra, Toon; Desmet, Peter; Ledegen, Hannes; Van de Poel, Sander; Pollet, Marc (Research Institute for Nature and Forest, INBO)
citation: Piesschaert F, Speybroeck J, Brosens D, Westra T, Desmet P, Ledegen H, Van de Poel S, Pollet M (2026). Meetnetten.be - Transects for fire salamanders in Flanders, Belgium. Version 1.22. Research Institute for Nature and Forest (INBO). Sampling event dataset. https://doi.org/10.15468/nbsk9h
abstract: Repeated night counts of fire salamanders (Salamandra salamandra) on 83 fixed forest transects of about 1 km in Flanders, from the Meetnetten.be priority-species monitoring network run by INBO and Natuurpunt Studie with specialised volunteers. Transects are walked between mid-August and mid-November on humid nights, at least twice a year. One row per visit: post-metamorphic salamanders counted.
samplingProtocol: Fixed transect of about 1 km walked at night in humid weather between 15 August and 15 November; salamanders searched for by flashlight within 6 m either side of the trail and counted; at least two visits a year (De Bruyn et al. 2015; Speybroeck et al. 2020).
closureNote: occasion = visit within an autumn season; period = calendar year; the population is treated as closed within the season by the protocol's design (repeat counts for N-mixture models)
geographicCoverage: Flanders, Belgium (INBO 5 km UTM centroids, coarsened to 0.1-degree cell centres)

coordinatesCoarsened.method: coarsen_coords(): the 5 km UTM-square centroids INBO publishes (coordinateUncertaintyInMeters 3536) snapped to their 0.1-degree cell centre, because Salamandra salamandra is IUCN VU (GBIF IUCN record, asserted) in its native range (E7, ruling on the publisher 2026-11-06); uncertainty = 3536 m plus the cell half-diagonal.

notes: 5 visits are dated outside August-November, kept as published. The source's occurrenceRemarks 'casual observation' is on every row, absences included, and is not a record type.

notShipped.row-level counts: a visit's count is split over several occurrence rows (mostly one per animal); summed into y
